value: Skipping every elite for a hard hallway (headline, one turn) is worth +14.0 end-HP (se 2.3, protocol pass at n 50; 0.920 vs 0.720 clears): the gauntlet pays nothing for elites, so this is the path ceiling. The plain rule 'skip under 40 HP' takes about a tenth: +1.53 HP (se 0.61, pass at n 83), firing on 11% of elite floors.
